BadgerDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization that governs a DeFi yield protocol. BadgerDAO operates vaults that automatically compound yield on deposited assets. BadgerDAO is governed by holders of its BADGER governance token. BadgerDAO was the target of a front-end compromise in December 2021 in which user funds were drained.

Poly Network is a cross-chain interoperability protocol that connects multiple public blockchains. Poly Network enables token and message transfers between separate blockchains. Poly Network was the target of a large exploit in August 2021 in which funds were stolen, and most of the funds were later returned.

Curve is a decentralized exchange that runs on public blockchains such as Ethereum. Curve uses automated market maker pools. Curve specializes in swaps between stablecoins and assets with similar prices. Curve is governed through its CRV governance token.

dYdX is a decentralized exchange for trading derivatives such as perpetual futures. dYdX originally ran on Ethereum using a Layer 2 scaling solution. dYdX uses an off-chain order book with on-chain settlement of trades. dYdX later moved its exchange to its own dedicated blockchain.
